dct_description_sm: This project was developed with the following objectives in mind: (1) To gather information to determine the volume of the water supplies in Arviat and Rankin Inlet, as well as to gather information on their physical characteristics to map them; (2) to involve communities in climate change research and provide Nunavumiut communities with an awareness to change; (3) - to train Nunavumiut in climate change data collection and use of equipment (i.e. flow meters, GPS, and depthfinder); and (4) to provide employment.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
dct_title_s: Addressing Data Need in Nunavut for Monitoring and Mapping Vulnerable Water Supplies: A Collaborative Approach in Support of Measures to be Taken Under the Nunavut Climate Change Adaptation Plan
